comparison: Ties t4-arch-v3 for top Tier-3 pass count (13/18) with complementary strengths: unified-v3 passes mode_hold, ring_extension, and target_shift_recovery plus 2/3 14k continuations, whereas t4-arch-v3 passes all 3/3 14k continuations, zero_tanh_rail_escape, and five_word_joint_smoke.
conclusion: On the untouched Tier-3 long-horizon holdout view (seed 0, zero tuning, 6060.7s), unified-v3 passed 13/18 tasks including two 14,000-update native continuations (rotated100 0.9856/0.6953 -> rotated100_14k 0.9865/0.4961; staggered100 0.9910/0.5863 -> staggered100_14k 0.9907/0.5147), uninterrupted 7500-step ring_extension (300/300 checks), and target_shift_recovery (81/81 live checks, min_hq=0.9160). It failed 2 tasks: grid100 (holdout passed 0.9867/0.6751 and 4/5 terminal checks passed, failing only step-6000 sustained live window acc=0.9180, gating grid100_14k) and zero_tanh_rail_escape (0.8795 MAE rail-trapped), and hit the 900s timeout INCOMPLETE on five_word_joint_smoke (gating five_word_joint_hold).

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Evaluate frozen unified-v3 without tuning under protocol seed 0 on the Round-3 Tier-3 long-horizon holdout suite (14,000-update fresh-process native continuations grid100_14k/rotated100_14k/staggered100_14k, 7,500-update uninterrupted ring_extension, 4,000-update five_word_joint_hold, target_shift_recovery, zero_tanh_rail_escape, and 3-task cheap smoke screen).
next_action: Document complementary frontier with t4-arch-v3 in reports/forge/studies/r3-calibration-holdout.md; do not promote without solving grid100 sustained window, rail escape, and accepted calibration.

study.competing_explanation: If unified-v3's learned equilibrium or prototype/atlas state drifts after 7,000 updates or across fresh-process checkpoint continuation, 14,000-update native accuracy or 7,500-step ring endurance will degrade below frozen thresholds.
